title: Customer records: embedding & JSON tags
hints: Promoted fields read like the customer's own: `c.City` is `c.Address.City`. `Label` starts from `s := c.Name` and appends `" <" + c.Email + ">"` and `" (" + c.City + ")"` only when they are non-empty. `ToJSON` is `b, err := json.Marshal(v)`, then `string(b)`.
A tag goes after the field type, in back quotes: ``Email string `json:"email,omitempty"` ``. Use `omitempty` for Email, Zip, Tags and Note; ``Password string `json:"-"` `` hides the password.

Leave the embedded `Address` line **without** a tag: then `encoding/json` flattens `street`, `city` and `zip` into the customer object. Tag the fields inside `Address` instead. `Order.Customer` gets ``json:"customer"``, which nests the object.
